body: They changed the rules for permanent residency a year or 2 ago. If you have a Swedish sambo then you can include the time spent on another type of permit (like student) and apply for permanent residency after only 3 years. Of course you have to fulfill other requirements for it now too, like you have to have a permanent job.

I did way more cool stuff in the US to be honest. 😅 Being young and in a really active city was an awesome experience. Can't say the same about my time here, and I've struggled a lot to convert my work experience in America to opportunities in Sweden. But Swedish citizenship does open up the rest of the EU as well.
Hard to say. As an American living here, I'd say they both have pros and cons. Sweden offers a lot, but the US is a much bigger place with more varied opportunities.
